mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies currently at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 72 degrees. The full moon is lighting up the night, and we expect an overnight low of 65 degrees with no rain predicted.

City residents should be aware that road surface treatments are scheduled from August 4 to August 7, starting on Lincoln Street. Additionally, the city is offering rebate programs for water-efficient toilets and rain barrels to help residents conserve resources.

There is plenty happening in town. Today you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy a concert at Century School Park, or head to Hop Haus Brewing Company for trivia. Looking ahead, you can enjoy music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree this Friday.
In a notable update from the Verona Police Department, an officer conducted a traffic stop on July 26 for a vehicle traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway, resulting in an O W I arrest.

You can enjoy the Caramel Turtle flavor of the day today. Please note the restaurant is currently closed, but they will open their doors again tomorrow at 10 AM. Tomorrow's flavor will be Raspberry Cheesecake.
